{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2013}}
{{main|2013 World Table Tennis Championships}}
[[Zhang Jike]] successfully defended the title by defeating [[Wang Hao (table tennis, born 1983)|Wang Hao]] 11–7, 11–8, 6–11, 14–12, 5–11, 11–7 in the final.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2190&Singles=1 Entry list]</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=31628&Competition_ID=2190&|title=Title Retained, Zhang Jike Clinches Gold at LIEBHERR World Championships|date=2013-05-20|work=ittf.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.reuters.com/article/us-table-tennis-world-idUSBRE94J0JP20130520|title= Zhang Jike wins world title to complete hat-trick|date=20 May 2013|work=Reuters|accessdate=23 May 2013 }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Singles matches were best of 7 games in qualification matches and best of 7 games in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2013/Playing_system_WTTC2013.pdf |title=2013 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |format=PDF |accessdate=11 May 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2190&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 |title=2013 WTTC Seeds&nbsp;– Men's singles |work=ittf.com |accessdate=11 May 2013 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130607120932/http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2190&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 |archivedate=7 June 2013 }}</ref>
